Either way, watch out for the boulders he throws, they stun!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 30 (Formerly, [[Polluted Wasteland II|Nuclear]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Abomination''' is a fast and tanky enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has a very high amount of health, fast speed and low defense. It also has [[Stun Immunity]], making it harder to slow down. Upon death, the '''Abomination''' will turn into the '''Reanimated'''. This gives it half of its health back, including the [[Shield Health]] gained from the [[Mutation]] modifier and a slight appearance change. The '''Abomination''' replaces the [[Tank]] in [[Oops! All slimes!]] [[Challenge Maps|Challenge Map]]. The '''Abomination''' used to be spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]], if it was not close enough to the exit. ==Appearance== The '''Abomination''' is a large humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It has a dark blue skin color and the ends of its limbs are coated in a green fluid. It has black armbands with grey spikes and abs with tumors and wounds on its chest. It has grey shoulder-pads which have cuts and blood on them. It also has two faceless heads, one being larger than the other. When it becomes the '''Reanimated''', its larger head will explode, with blood particles and a red spot being where the head once was, and it will also gain glowing red veins on its upper arms and a red outline. ==Mutation== ===Nuclear=== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |1,250 |- !Wave !Health |- |21 |26,250 |- |22 |27,500 |- |23 |28,750 |- |24 |30,000 |- |25 |31,250 |} ===Oops! All slimes!=== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin:0 auto;" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |8% |480 |- !Wave !Health |- |31 |6,480 |- |32 |6,960 |- |33 |7,440 |- |34 |7,920 |- |35 |8,400 |- |36 |8,880 |- |37 |9,360 |- |38 |9,840 |- |39 |10,320 |- |40 |10,800 |} ==Strategy== *Use high DPS towers such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Engineer]] to defeat this enemy. **Do note that when the '''Abomination''' transforms into the '''Reanimated''', the [[Accelerator]] will lock onto a different enemy. This may end up letting the '''Reanimated''' get past it, if you do not have any other high DPS towers. *Note that, outside of its debut wave (where it has the [[Boss]] attribute), the [[Hacker]] can convert the '''Abomination''', completely cancelling its '''Two Hearts & Two Brains''' ability and making it far less threatening. **The [[Hacker]] can also slow down the '''Abomination''' in the process, rendering it almost entirely irrelevant if you have enough damage to deal with it in the first place. *The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be very useful at decreasing the firerate of towers and increasing their range. *The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] will not stun it but only slow it down because of its [[Stun Immunity]]. Additionally, the [[Warden]] will slow it down for a shorter amount of time due to the '''Abomination's''' size. **Knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] cannot knock it back as it has the [[Stun Immunity]]. **Due to this, it's generally best to use freezing towers such as the [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]] to stall it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseAbomination.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- ☢️ NUCLEAR Update!☢️|'''Abomination''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexAbomination.png|'''Abomination''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Abomination''' is the first enemy to revive itself from death. *The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] used to improperly call this enemy a [[Tank]]. This was due to the [[Polluted Wasteland II]] dialogue being borrowed from the [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode dialogue before the [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022 Update]]. **The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] also mentioned it being able to throw boulders, something that neither the [[Tank]] nor '''Abomination''' can do. ***The [[Tank]] used to be able to throw boulders before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue for the [[Tank]] was not updated when the [[Tank]] lost its ability. *The '''Abomination''' was based on a fan idea from the Tower Defense Simulator Discord server. ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Abomination''' added. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] replaced with [[Stun Immunity]]. *'''19 July 2024''' - [[v1.26.0]] **Health decreased from 20,000 to 6,000 in [[Oops! All slimes!]]. *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **Modern version added. ***None of the changes are applied to the legacy version. **Speed increased from Fast (6) to Very Fast (8.5). **Defense increased from 20% to 30%. **Now gives {{Money|8,750}} every 25% health. **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Health increased from 20,000 to 25,000. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. ==Notes== {{PollutedWasteland|[[Super Slime]]|Wave 19|Abomination|Wave 20|[[Super Toxic]]|Wave 21}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Late-Game]]
